page.layout: One printed page. Running head and page number at top. Main text in one column with headings and verse stanzas. Marginal notes in left margin beside the verse, in small type. Ends with a catchword-like hyphenated word "Huma-" at lower right.

p.i: Hi tibi Nomentum, & Gabios, vrbémque Fidenam, Hi Collatinas imponent montibus arces, Laude pudicitia celebres, addéntque superbos Pometios, Castrúmque Inui, Bolámque, Corámque, Hæc tum nomina erunt, nunc sunt sine nomine terra.
Est prope piscosos lapidosi Crathidis amnes Parvus ager: Camerem incola turba vocat.

Vmbria te notis antiqua penatibus edit. Mentior? an patria tangitur ora tua? Quà nebulosa cavo rorat Meuania campo, Et lacus aestiuis intepet Vmber aquis, Scandentisque axis consurgit vertice murus, Murus ab ingenio notior ille tuo.

p.note: Stat. lib. 1. Syluarum. Clitumnus fluuius in Vmbr.
p.i: —necsi vacuet Meuania valles, Aut præstent niveos Clitumna noualia tauros, Sufficiam, sed sæpe Deis hos inter honores Cespes, & exiguo placuerunt farra salino.

Quin & Clitumni sacras victoribus undas, Candida quæ Latius prabent armenta triumphis, Visere cura fuit. nec te miracula fontis Prætereuntiacito passu quem siquis adiret, Lentus erat: si voce gradum maiore citasset,
Commissis feruebat aquis. cumque omnibus una Sit natura vadis, similes vt corporis umbras Offendant: hæc sola nouam iactantia fortem,

page.notes: Printed marginal notes are partly abbreviated and damaged at the left edge; "Hi Collatinas" and similar verse words are copied as printed. The line "Præterennt: tacito" and "Commiss" readings are doubtful. Notes are placed beside the first line of their stanza.
